    Why We Built Coroot

    Picture this:

    It's 3 AM, your app is down, and you're staring at a dashboard that shows you everything except what's actually broken.

    We've all been there. That's why we started Coroot in 2021.

    Instead of more charts and graphs, we built something that actually tells you what's wrong and how to fix it.

    What We Believe

    Simple ideas that shape everything we build

    Built for Engineers

    We think like you do. No more wrestling with tools that just don't get it.

    Automate the Toil

    Telemetry, correlation, data crunching — if it can be automated, Coroot does it for you, so you can focus on fixing problems instead of collecting data.

    No Magic

    Every finding comes with proof. No more "trust me, bro" debugging.

    The Goal

    Make every engineer better at their job.

    We want you to sleep better at night, ship with confidence, and actually enjoy being on-call. Revolutionary? Maybe. Possible? Absolutely.
